<thought>Chlorine shows a characteristic M+2 peak at about one‑third the intensity of the monoisotopic peak, which matches the observed 33 % M+2 intensity. No other element produces such a strong, distinct M+2 pattern in this spectrum, so chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
